Front to back: a 3-stone stepping path (z 1.25/1.55/1.85) leads to a blue split Dutch door with cream frame on the tower front; a lantern hangs beside the door; one warm-glow window sits on the tower front at y 1.25 and two more on the tower sides. The round brick tower (y 0-2.2, r 0.98 at base with a bulging plinth y 0-0.06, r 0.90 at y 0.25, tapering to r 0.70 at y 2.2; r(y) = 0.90 - 0.205*(y-0.25)/1.95 between) rises through a grass mound (dome r 1.6, h 0.32). A squat thatched dome cap (y 3.0-3.82, r 0.70 bulging to 0.74 at y 3.12 then closing to 0.10 at y 3.78) wears 4 dark thatch bands, an eaves ring with a fringe of little cones, and a cream finial ball at (0, 4.0). A square wooden windshaft (0.14 across) runs from inside the dome front to an iron hub at [0, 3.6, 1.1]; four sail units sweep the vertical XY plane at z = 1.1 (canvas centred at z 1.18): whips 1.9 long along ±X and ±Y with crossbars at r 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 and canvas panels r 0.55-0.98 and 1.02-1.48; the bottom sail tip hovers at (0, 1.7, 1.1) just in front of the door lintel, the top tip reaches y 5.5, the side tips x ±1.9. A wooden tail pole runs from the cap rear (0, 3.45, -0.45) down to a short post standing on the mound at (0, ~0.1, -1.5), with 4 ladder rungs and a small wheel (r 0.17) at its lower end, behind the mill.

Animal Crossing tone on every part: brick tower in warm terracotta with cream mortar bands and quoins, cream trim, glowing amber window glass, golden thatch, bright grass with pink/yellow tulips, daisies and a bush. The mound, path, flowers and bushes are simpler than the windmill itself and sized to its footprint.
